scripts.dev: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo dev
scripts.build: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo build
scripts.generate: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo generate
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && cd apps/desktop && go test ./...
scripts.lint: eslint . && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint:go && bun run lint:dup
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && bun run fmt && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run --fix
scripts.lint:go: go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt --diff && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bunx lint-staged && bunx jscpd --silent && bunx knip
